nodes.content: Develop visual question answering that responds to causally relevant image changes while remaining invariant to distractors under compositional shift.
requirements: Answer both original and answer-changing counterfactual images correctly on at least 80% of fixed-question pairs.
Limit answer changes under irrelevant visual edits to 5% on unseen object–attribute combinations.

nodes.content: Train question-grounded object-slot VQA with paired counterfactual losses enforcing answer flips for relevant edits and invariance for distractor edits.
Can paired counterfactual training keep object-slot attention on the queried object when unfamiliar attribute combinations make distractors salient?
Paired counterfactual losses will maintain ≥75% attention on the queried-object slot and ≤5% distractor-induced answer flips on unseen object–attribute combinations.
Build CompoCF splits with unseen object–attribute pairings; train slot VQA, then measure queried-slot attention, pair accuracy, and distractor-flip rate.
Train paired-loss slot VQA on CompoCF, then score queried-slot attention, distractor-flip rate, and pair accuracy on held-out combinations.
On CompoCF held-out combinations, paired-loss slot VQA achieved 79% queried-slot attention, 3.8% distractor flips, and 83% counterfactual-pair accuracy.
Retain paired-loss slot VQA as the lead method: 83% counterfactual-pair accuracy and 3.8% distractor flips clear both targets.
Freeze retained paired-loss slot VQA; run blinded CompoCF-v2 evaluation of answer-changing pairs and irrelevant edits on new combinations.
CompoCF-v2 evaluation package containing the frozen checkpoint, held-out split manifests, pairwise correctness, and distractor-flip tables.
Can paired counterfactual losses prevent reliance on edit-generator artifacts that correlate with answer changes?
Test frozen paired-loss slot VQA on CompoCF-v2 cross-generator edits and artifact-only shams; measure pair accuracy and sham-flip rate.
On CompoCF-v2 cross-generator edits, frozen paired-loss slot VQA reached 68% pair accuracy and 12% artifact-only sham flips.
Train artifact-balanced slot VQA with multi-generator edits, matched artifact-only shams, and object-mask consistency to suppress edit shortcuts.
Balance CompoCF-v2 edits against artifact-only shams, retrain with object-mask consistency, then test cross-generator pair accuracy and distractor flips.
Using n10’s checkpoint and split manifests, retrain slot VQA on balanced multi-generator edits and artifact-only shams with object-mask consistency.
ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 checkpoint with multi-generator edit/sham training manifests and object-mask consistency settings.
Evaluate ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 on untouched CompoCF-v2 cross-generator pairs and irrelevant edits; report pair accuracy, distractor flips, sham flips.
On untouched CompoCF-v2 cross-generator splits, ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 achieved 82% pair accuracy, 4.1% distractor flips, and 2.7% sham flips.
Does ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 maintain ≥80% pair accuracy on answer-changing occlusions that alter queried-object masks?
Object-mask consistency will preserve ≥80% pair accuracy when answer-changing occlusions partially hide queried objects on held-out CompoCF-v2 pairs.
Construct human-validated, answer-changing CompoCF-v2 partial-occlusion pairs altering queried-object masks; measure frozen ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 fixed-question pair accuracy.
On human-validated CompoCF-v2 partial-occlusion pairs, frozen ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 achieved 71% pair accuracy, below the hypothesized 80%.
Retrain v2 without object-mask consistency; compare CompoCF-v2 occlusion-pair accuracy by queried-object visibility and mask overlap.
On ≥70%-visible partial occlusions, mask consistency yielded 84% pair accuracy versus 75% without, despite failing the overall threshold.
Retain mask consistency for ≥70%-visible objects, but prioritize occlusion-aware training; overall occlusion-pair accuracy remains 71%.
Extend ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v2 with visibility-gated mask consistency and occlusion counterfactual training to recover partially hidden queried objects.
Train visibility-gated v3 on occlusion counterfactuals plus balanced shams; evaluate pair accuracy and irrelevant-edit flips on unseen combinations.
Annotate queried-object visibility, gate mask consistency at ≥70%, and retrain v3 on paired occlusions and matched shams.
VisibilityGated-SlotVQA v3 checkpoint with ≥70%-visibility mask gating, paired-occlusion training manifests, and matched-sham annotations.
Benchmark v3 on held-out CompoCF-v2 partial occlusions and unseen object–attribute edits; measure pair accuracy and irrelevant-edit flip rate.
On CompoCF-v2 unseen combinations, v3 achieved 78% occlusion-pair accuracy and 6.2% irrelevant-edit flips, missing both targets.
Can visibility gating and matched shams prevent occlusion training from making irrelevant occluder textures trigger answer changes?
Run texture-swapped occluder shams on frozen v3 and v2, stratified by queried-object visibility; measure texture-induced answer-flip rates.
On ≥70%-visible texture-swapped occluder shams, v3 flipped 3.4% of answers versus v2’s 8.1%.
Below 70% visibility, v3 will exceed 5% texture-induced flips because mask consistency is disabled, unlike 3.4% above threshold.
Match texture-swapped occluder shams by object, occlusion geometry, and generator; compare v3 answer-flip rates below versus above 70% visibility.
Matched texture-swapped shams produced 9.0% v3 answer flips below 70% visibility versus 3.5% above.
Ablate v3’s 70% gate by enabling mask consistency below threshold; compare low-visibility texture-sham flips and occlusion-pair accuracy.
Enabling below-threshold mask consistency left sham flips at 9.1% versus 9.0% gated; occlusion-pair accuracy fell from 78% to 75%.
Keep the 70% gate; address low-visibility texture shortcuts separately, since ungating leaves sham flips near 9% and reduces pair accuracy.
Low-visibility texture flips reflect shortcut learning rather than disabled mask consistency; texture-balanced sham training should reduce them below 5%.
Retain v3’s gate; train v4 with texture-matched low-visibility edits and shams, then compare sham flips and pair accuracy.
Retrain gated v4 with texture-matched low-visibility edits and shams; test held-out texture-swap flip rate against v3’s 9.0%.
On held-out low-visibility texture-swap shams, texture-balanced gated v4 cut answer flips from v3’s 9.0% to 4.6%.
Retrain gated v4 without texture balancing; compare unseen-generator low-visibility sham flips and occlusion-pair accuracy against balanced v4.
On unseen-generator low-visibility shams, balanced v4 flipped 8.2% versus unbalanced v4’s 8.0%; occlusion-pair accuracy was 77% versus 78%.
Defer texture-balanced v4: held-out sham flips fell to 4.6%, but unseen-generator flips reached 8.2% without accuracy gains.
Generator-specific occluder cues, not texture imbalance alone, drive low-visibility flips; cross-generator style randomization should cut unseen-generator sham flips below 5%.
Run a texture-balancing × mask-consistency ablation on unseen-generator low-visibility shams; measure answer-flip rates and occlusion-pair accuracy.
On unseen-generator shams, texture balancing with below-threshold mask consistency cut flips from 10.3% unbalanced to 4.8% balanced.
Train gated v5 with cross-generator occluder-style randomization; compare unseen-generator low-visibility sham flips and pair accuracy against balanced v4.
On unseen-generator low-visibility shams, style-randomized v5 flipped 7.6% versus balanced v4’s 8.2%; occlusion-pair accuracy reached 78%.
Defer v4/v5 despite 4.6% held-out flips: unseen-generator flips remain 8.2%/7.6%; test joint balancing and low-visibility consistency (4.8%), pending pair accuracy.
Train v6 with texture-balanced cross-generator shams and confidence-weighted low-visibility mask consistency to curb flips without sacrificing occlusion-pair accuracy.
Train v6 with texture-balanced cross-generator shams and confidence-weighted mask consistency; evaluate occlusion-pair accuracy and irrelevant-edit flips on unseen combinations.
Using n10’s split manifests to exclude held-out pairs, fine-tune v3 with texture-balanced cross-generator shams and confidence-weighted low-visibility consistency.
ArtifactBalanced-SlotVQA v6 checkpoint with cross-generator sham manifests, texture-balance weights, and confidence-weighted low-visibility consistency configuration.
Evaluate frozen v6 on untouched CompoCF-v2 unseen-generator occlusion pairs and irrelevant edits; stratify accuracy and flips by queried-object visibility.
On untouched CompoCF-v2 unseen-generator splits, v6 achieved 81% occlusion-pair accuracy, 4.3% irrelevant-edit flips, and 4.7% low-visibility sham flips.
Select v6 as the lead method: 81% occlusion-pair accuracy and 4.3% irrelevant-edit flips meet both targets on unseen-generator splits.
Train question-conditioned causal scene-graph VQA with graph interventions for relevant edits and nuisance-node dropout for distractor invariance.
Can graph interventions preserve queried spatial relations while nuisance-node dropout suppresses distractor attributes on unseen object–attribute combinations?
Causal scene-graph VQA will reach ≥80% spatial-relation pair accuracy with ≤5% distractor flips on unseen object–attribute combinations.
Initialize scene-graph nodes from v6 checkpoint slots; test spatial-relation pair accuracy and distractor flips on unseen CompoCF-v2 combinations.
On unseen CompoCF-v2 combinations, causal scene-graph VQA achieved 83% spatial-relation pair accuracy and 4.2% distractor flips.
Retain causal scene-graph VQA as a spatial-relation specialist; 83% pair accuracy and 4.2% distractor flips satisfy both targets.
Route spatial-relation questions to the retained scene-graph specialist and others to v6; validate aggregate pair accuracy and irrelevant-edit flips.
Train spatial-question router using v2 manifests and v6 embeddings; score routed pair accuracy and irrelevant-edit flips on held-out CompoCF-v2.
CompoCF-v2 routed-VQA package with spatial-question router, v6 and scene-graph checkpoints, held-out predictions, and pair/flip scoring scripts.
Evaluate routed-VQA against v6-only and scene-graph-only on untouched CompoCF-v2; report spatial and overall pair accuracy and distractor-flip rates.
On untouched CompoCF-v2, routed-VQA achieved 84% overall pair accuracy, 85% spatial-pair accuracy, and 4.0% distractor flips.
Release routed-VQA (84% pair accuracy, 4.0% flips); retain v6 as its default model and v2 as a regression baseline.
